title: Baked Salmon Papillote
description: A simple and flavorful baked salmon recipe wrapped in parchment paper.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place a salmon fillet in the center of the parchment paper.
Drizzle 1 tablespoon of olive oil over the salmon.
Sprinkle salt and pepper to taste.
Top the salmon with lemon juice, garlic, and chopped dill.
Fold the parchment paper over the salmon to form a packet.
Place the packet on the prepared baking sheet.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until the salmon is cooked through.
Remove from the oven and let rest for 2-3 minutes before serving.
